rows.adsb_note: SAYS ALMOST NOTHING. adsb-lol/airplanes-live served other airframes that day but holds no trace for this one. Parked with the transponder off, outside receiver coverage, and a wrong claimed date all look identical from here. AN ABSENCE IS NOT A FINDING.

rows.counterargument: A CHAPTER OPENING IS NOT A KIRK APPEARANCE - nothing places Charlie Kirk in Lincoln on this date. The aircraft arrived 9 Feb and left 14 Feb: it did not arrive for the event and did not leave with it. THE DOCUMENTARY COUNTERARGUMENT IS DECISIVE: a Duncan Aviation press release of 29 Oct 2015 records a five-year direct contract with the Egyptian Air Force and states Duncan has managed the EAF Falcon fleet's maintenance SINCE 1999 - fifteen years before Charlie Kirk's public career. AND THE 2023 COUNTER-CASE IS STRONGER: on 25 Aug 2023 Charlie Kirk actually spoke in Lincoln, and the audit places the aircraft IN EGYPT that day.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The clearest genuine same-airport co-location in the directory - and the one with the most ordinary explanation sitting directly on top of it. A weaker item sits three days earlier: Charlie Kirk's campus tour was publicly ANNOUNCED on 8 Feb 2024 and SU-BTT arrived at Omaha the next morning. AN ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A LOCATION.

This trace holds no on-ground positions at all, which is ordinary: receiver coverage of a parked aircraft is thin. It places NOBODY aboard.
rows.source: TPUSA tour press list (event); audit index 23 accurate, index 24 partial
rows.counterargument: THE PAIRING POINTS THE WRONG WAY. On the one day Charlie Kirk is documented in Kansas, the aircraft LEFT - departing at 08:43 am and flying out of the state. It had already sat at Wichita five days, arriving 29 Mar, well before a 3 Apr Lawrence appearance was operationally relevant to anything. Nearest airports to the venue are KLWC and KMCI (~50 mi), NOT Wichita, 160 miles away. Wichita is the Air Capital of the World and Yingling Aviation at KICT is an FAA Part 145 Dassault Falcon service centre: a Falcon 7X landing at Wichita is the most ordinary thing a Falcon 7X can do.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. The strongest Kansas pairing in the record, and it cuts against the claim. THE WICHITA TALLY IS THE CLEAREST ILLUSTRATION OF HOW THESE COUNTS INFLATE: a claim of 'no fewer than 8 stops' by SU-BTT at Wichita resolves against the audit into THREE confirmed visits (Nov 2022, Apr 2023, Mar-Apr 2024) plus NINE claimed Wichita entries on dates the aircraft was in Egypt (indices 22, 31, 32, 33, 34, 45, 51, 54, 59, 61, 63), TWO of which are literal duplicates of two others (61 duplicates 31; 63 duplicates 33).

rows.source: Compilation spreadsheet circulated by trackers; alternate tracker read @troofevades (takeoff ~13:14 UTC, landing ~16:52 UTC); audit index 41 (flight confirmed, origin corrected from 'Paris' to Provo)
rows.counterargument: 'NEBRASKA/DELAWARE' IS NOT A LOCATION - it is two states 1,200 miles apart offered as alternatives in a cell that should hold one place. NO AIRCRAFT IN THIS FLEET WAS IN NEBRASKA ON 10 SEP 2025: the Lincoln rotation ran 17-23 August and did not resume until 5-11 October, so half the claimed location has no aircraft behind it at all. The Delaware half has an aircraft, but Wilmington is the aircraft's ordinary destination - it appears on the OUTBOUND leg of twenty-one rotations across three years, and ONLY ever the outbound leg. Erika Kirk has said she stayed home in Arizona with her mother that day. Neither version is independently documented.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. ERIKA'S SIDE IS THE WEAK SIDE and this row is the concrete form of it: the flight is audited and confirmed, the Kirk-side location is an unverified spreadsheet cell that the person it describes has contradicted. Her flight logs are reported erased - see site/docs/Planes/Erika-Flight-Logs-Erased.mdx. Erika Kirk is a living person, not charged with anything, named here only as the subject of a disputed claim she has denied.
